rows.name: Sunk Lightvessel
rows.description: In 9½ fathoms; red and bright flash alternately; half ball above ball. Gong; warning gun

rows.name: Kentish Knock Lt.-vessel
rows.description: Has two red balls vertically. In 11 fathoms on E. side of Sand. Fog-horn 5 secs. ev. min.

rows.name: GALLOPER LIGHT-VES.
rows.description: In 20 fathoms on S.W. side of Shoal; lights horizontal. Gong; warning gun

rows.name: NORTH FORELAND
rows.description: White tower 85 ft. high. A strip of red light to E. end of Margate Sand, between N. ¾ E. and N. by W. ½ W.

rows.name: Ramsgate, Tide Lights
rows.character: 1. Red or green light on West pier 2. Green lt. on W. cliff 3. Green lt. on E. cliff 4. Sparkling lt. 10 secs., on East pier
rows.description: 1. Red lt. while more than 10 ft. in entrance, or from 2½h. before, and 3½h. after high water; changed to green lt. when less than 10 ft. 2. Green lt. in one with W. pier lt. leads through Old Cudd Channel 3. Green lt. in one with ditto leads through Ramsgate Channel 4. Visible 5 secs., invisible 5 secs.

rows.name: GOODWIN LT.-VESSEL
rows.description: Off N. end of the Goodwin Sands, in 10 fms. Lt. shows 3 flashes in quick succession, and is obscured for 36 secs. in ev. min. Three masts & balls by day. Gong. Warning-gun

rows.name: EAST GOOWIN LT.-V.
rows.description: About 1½ mile to the eastward of the Goodwin Sands, in 30 fathoms. Half diamond over diamond at mast-head. Gong; warning gun

rows.name: GULL STREAM LT.-VES.
rows.description: On the West side of the Goodwin Sands, in 8 fathoms. Gong; warning gun

rows.name: S. SAND HEAD LT.-VES.
rows.description: Off the South end of the Good[?]in Sands, in 14 fathoms. Fog-trumpet 5 secs. every 2 min.

rows.name: SOUTH FORELAND
rows.description: In one W. by N., 1,347 ft. apart; in one, clear S. of Goodwin. High lt. cut off on a S.W. by S. bearing. Magneto-electric apparatus

rows.name: DOVER Admiralty Pier
rows.description: Red tower, 30 ft. high, on end of Admiralty Pier. Fog Bell ev. 7½ secs.

rows.name: Dover Harbour
rows.character: One green light Red Tide Lights
rows.description: One red lt. on N. pier while 7 ft.; one red lt. on S. pier while 7 to 10 ft.; two red lts. while above 10 ft. The green lt. at the W. side of entr. to Granville Dock

rows.name: Folkestone Tide Lights
rows.character: 1. Red and bright lts. 2. Green light
rows.description: 1. On S. pier head a red light while 10 ft.; a white light below it when above 16 ft.; when red lt. is blinked occasionally use caution ... 2. On new pier a green light seaward, but white inshore of danger Fog Bell

rows.name: VARNE LIGHTVESSEL
rows.description: In 16 fathoms at West end of the shoal. Gong. Warning-gun

rows.name: DUNGENESS
rows.character: 1. One fixed light 2. One br. flash. lt. ev. 5 secs.
rows.description: 1. Tower with red and white belts, 240 yds. f[?]om extr. of point. Red lt. over W. anchorage northward of W., and red lt. over E. anchorage W. of N.E. by E. ½ E. 2. New tower on extr. of pt. S.S.E. ½ E. 675 ft. from main lt. Fog-horn 5 secs. ev. min.

rows.name: Rye Tide Lights
rows.character: 1. Two bright fixed lts. 2. Two red fixed lights. 3. One green fixed light
rows.description: 1. Camber, on N. side of the entrance while 10 feet; in one N. ½ W. 2. Near old pier head from half flood to half ebb 3. West entrance to harbour half flood to half ebb
